routes.name: Sustainable Island State Contribution
routes.summary: Citizenship by investment through a contribution of at least US$250,000 for a main applicant or a family of up to four. Extra dependants cost more.

investment.note: Covers the main applicant or a family of up to four members.

other: Applications go through an Authorised Agent
Main applicant must attend an interview (virtual or in person)
No residence in St Kitts and Nevis required
Not eligible: denied citizenship or a visa by another country, criminal record or investigation, bankruptcy in the last 10 years
Applications not accepted from citizens of Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, Iraq, North Korea and Russia
Dependants: spouse, children under 18, children 18 to 30 in full-time school and fully supported, disabled adult children, parents 55+ living with and supported by the applicant

fees.label: Due diligence, each dependant 16 or over

routes.processing: The CIU says that within 120 to 180 days of acknowledging your submission it will tell you if the application is approved in principle, denied, or delayed for cause.

citizenship.note: The CIU says dual citizenship is allowed and there is no residency requirement.

routes.name: Developer's Real Estate Investment

investment.note: Paid to the developer for each main applicant. Resaleable after seven years.

other: Applications go through an Authorised Agent

Dependants: spouse, children under 18, children 18 to 30 in full-time school and fully supported, disabled adult children, parents 55+ living with and supported by the applicant
Buying costs like the compulsory insurance fund contribution and conveyance fees are extra

routes.name: Private Real Estate Investment
routes.summary: Citizenship by buying Approved Private Real Estate: US$325,000 minimum for a condo unit or share, US$600,000 minimum for a single-family home. You can't resell for seven years.

investment.note: US$325,000 minimum for a condo unit or share. US$600,000 minimum for a single-family home.

other: Applications go through an Authorised Agent
Main applicant must attend an interview (virtual or in person)
No residence in St Kitts and Nevis required
Not eligible: denied citizenship or a visa by another country, criminal record or investigation, bankruptcy in the last 10 years
Applications not accepted from citizens of Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, Iraq, North Korea and Russia
Dependants: spouse, children under 18, children 18 to 30 in full-time school and fully supported, disabled adult children, parents 55+ living with and supported by the applicant
Selling before seven years means the property can't be used for a later application unless Cabinet accepts substantial further investment
